{{Dialogue|Allana|Dordi, Zal&mdash;are you in the turrets?|Dordi|Dordi on the back&hellip;|Zal|And Zal in the belly.|attr=Allana Solo, Dordi, and Zal|src=<ref name="Abyss" />}}
'''Zal''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Barabel/Legends|Barabel]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] in the [[New Jedi Order]]. During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], she served [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Saba Sebatyne]] in her [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]], the [[Wild Knights]]. In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], Zal and fellow Barabel [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Knights [[Dordi]] and [[Wilyem]] served as [[Gunner/Legends|gunners]] for [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] in the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] to [[Toydarian double-reverse spinner|distract]] [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] forces while his wife, [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], smuggled four Jedi suffering from a [[Force psychosis|psychosis]] offworld in the ''[[Gizer Gut]]'' before they could be captured by [[Galactic Alliance Security]] and encased in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]]. In [[44 ABY]], Zal began a nest with Wilyem, as well as Dordi and Sebatyne's son, [[Tesar Sebatyne|Tesar]], in the sub-basement of the [[New Jedi Temple|Jedi Temple]]. The Barabels stayed behind with their nest when the Jedi left the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in an attempt to lure the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] into a trap. Soon afterward, the Solos' granddaughter [[Allana Djo Solo|Allana]]&mdash;who had accidentally discovered the Barabels' nest sometime previously and had sworn herself to secrecy&mdash;returned with her [[Parent/Legends|grandparents]], as well as Jedi Knight [[Zekk]] and the [[Hapan]] [[Taryn Zel]], to warn the Barabels of a [[Force vision/Legends|Force vision]] she had of their [[Youngling/Legends|younglings]] being [[Death/Legends|killed]]. The Barabels [[Assault on the New Jedi Temple|evacuated]] their nest and were extracted from the Temple aboard the ''[[Parting Gift]]'', [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] by the former [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial]] [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]], [[Jagged Fel]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|<nowiki></nowiki>''Tesar? Dordi?"<br />"''And Wilyem and Zal.|Allana Solo and Zal, as the former stumbles upon the Barabels' nest|<ref name="Vortex">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Vortex]]''</ref>}}
Zal was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Barabel/Legends|Barabel]] who served in the [[New Jedi Order]]. She [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side of the Force]] and served as a member of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Saba Sebatyne]]'s all-[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Wild Knights]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. By [[43 ABY]], she had attained the rank of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]. Around this time, she and fellow Barabel Jedi Knight [[Dordi]] considered starting a nest with Sebatyne's son, [[Tesar Sebatyne]]. In 43.5 ABY, several young Jedi Knights began to fall prey to a [[Force psychosis|mysterious illness]] that caused them to believe that everyone they knew had been replaced by impostors, and the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] decided to deal with the psychotic Knights by encasing them in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]]. The Jedi Order resisted this, however, and secretly kept as many of the ill Jedi as possible hidden in the [[New Jedi Temple]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to be studied.<ref name="Abyss" />

[[File:HanSolo-Vortex.jpg|thumb|left|225px|Captain Han Solo]]
To prevent [[Galactic Alliance Security]] forces from finding and capturing these Jedi, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and his wife, Jedi Knight [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], decided to smuggle them offworld to the planet [[Shedu Maad]]. Zal, along with fellow Barabel Knights Dordi and [[Wilyem]], served as [[Gunner/Legends|gunners]] in the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] under Han Solo and his granddaughter, [[Allana Djo Solo|Allana Solo]]. They were to [[Toydarian double-reverse spinner|distract]] Galactic Alliance forces in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] over Coruscant, allowing Organa Solo to escape with the affected Jedi&mdash;[[Natua Wan]], [[Seff Hellin]], [[Bazel Warv]], and [[Yaqeel Saav'etu]]&mdash;in the ''[[Gizer Gut]]''.<ref name="Abyss" />

The ''Millennium Falcon'' broke every procedure for departing the planet; the Galactic Alliance's [[Bolt Squadron (Galactic Alliance)|Bolt Squadron]] and the ''[[Fast Death]]'', a [[Nargi-class pursuit frigate|''Nargi''-class pursuit frigate]], began to chase them down. Solo maneuvered the ''Falcon'' behind [[PharmCom Orbital Processing Plant One]], an orbiting pharmaceutical production plant, and the ''Fast Death'' stayed behind, to be replaced by another pursuit [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]], the ''[[Quick End]]''. Solo then told Allana to alert Master Sebatyne, and proceeded to order Zal and Dordi to pull up their guns and targeting computer systems as a bluff. Sebatyne arrived with a squadron of [[StealthX]]s and quickly scattered Bolt Squadron. Wilyem then fired a [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedo]], which detonated a few kilometers off their stern. Solo pretended to spin out of control toward the ''Quick End'', and revealed to the Galactic Alliance that he had Allana&mdash;who was disguised as his adopted daughter "Amelia"&mdash;on board. The frigate then maneuvered out of his way, and at Solo's orders, Allana reached out in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to Organa Solo, signaling her to leave. She quickly escaped offworld with the four psychotic Jedi in the ''Gizer Gut''. The Galactic Alliance forces broke off their pursuit, and, their objective complete, Dordi, Zal, Wilyem, and the Solos jumped into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] to meet up with the ''Gizer Gut'' at Shedu Maad.<ref name="Abyss" />

In [[44 ABY]], Zal began a nest with Wilyem in the [[New Jedi Temple|Jedi Temple's]] underlevels, along with Dordi and Tesar Sebatyne. They were stumbled upon by Amelia and Jedi Knight Bazel Warv, one of the Jedi they had helped to smuggle offworld, and who had since recovered from the psychosis. The Barabels were outraged at first, and demanded that since they had seen the nest and their eggs, Amelia and Warv would have to stay until the eggs hatched. Amelia, however, suggested that she tell them a secret about herself that was as important as the Barabels' nest, and revealed to them her true identity as Allana, daughter of Jedi [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] and [[Queen Mother]] [[Tenel Ka Djo]], and thus the rightful heir to the [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapes Consortium]]. Zal and the other Barabels agreed to the terms and allowed Allana and Warv to leave.<ref name="Vortex" />

[[File:Allana_Solo.jpg|thumb|right|175px|Allana Solo]]
Upon the [[Lost Tribe of Sith emergence|rise]] of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] affairs, the Jedi decided to leave Coruscant in an attempt to lure the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] into a trap, so that the Jedi could effectively eliminate the Tribe in one mission. Zal and the three other Barabrels, however, remained behind in the Temple. When the Jedi returned and began [[Liberation of Coruscant (Lost Tribe of Sith emergence)|hunting down]] the Sith, the Tribe retreated into the Temple. Meanwhile, Allana had a [[Force vision/Legends|vision]] of the Barabels' nest being attacked and their [[Youngling/Legends|younglings]] being [[Death/Legends|slaughtered]], and she&mdash;along with her [[Parent/Legends|grandparents]], the Jedi Knight [[Zekk]], the Hapan [[Taryn Zel]], and several Hapan [[Commando/Legends|commandos]]&mdash;traveled to the Temple and located the nest to warn the Barabels. Zal was the only one of the four Barabels who did not come out to meet with them.<ref name="Apoc">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]''</ref>

They quickly gathered the younglings and fled the nest, [[Assault on the New Jedi Temple|fighting]] the Sith on their way out. They suffered casualties, including numerous Hapan soldiers and some of the younglings, leaving twenty of the newborn Barabels alive. The Barabels and their rescuers were extracted from the Jedi Temple by the former [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Jagged Fel]], who piloted the ''[[Parting Gift]]'', along with Master Saba Sebatyne, [[Void Jumper]] [[Sergeant major/Legends|Sergeant Major]] [[Gef Olazon]], and the former Jedi [[Tahiri Veila]].<ref name="Apoc" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|When you need crazy&mdash;''"<br />"''&mdash;call a Barabel.|Han and Allana Solo|<ref name="Abyss" />}}
Zal shared a sense of humor with other Barabels that other beings rarely understood. Much of what was said between the crew of the ''Millennium Falcon'' during her mission with the Solos was taken as a joke between the Barabel Jedi. Even when they were under pressure, Zal kept her sense of humor and remained high-spirited.<ref name="Abyss" /> When Allana and Warv accidentally discovered Zal's nest, she and the other Barabels were outraged, and tried to force the two to stay in the nest until their eggs hatched. However, when Allana offered an exchange of secrets, Zal inquired as to whether the secret was as big as their nest, and when Allana reassured her that it was and went on to reveal it, the Barabels allowed the two intruders to leave.<ref name="Vortex" />

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|No, you can't shoot! What are you, crazy? I've got Amelia on board!|Han Solo, telling Zal and Dordi they can't open fire|<ref name="Abyss" />}}
Zal learned the ways of the Force with the Jedi Order and rose to the rank of Jedi Knight. She was a skillful pilot, and she flew with Saba Sebatyne's Wild Knights during the Yuuzhan Vong War. Zal was also a capable gunner; however, she and Dordi were ordered not to [[Laser/Legends|fire]] on the Galactic Alliance [[Starship/Legends|ships]] during their mission with Solo.<ref name="Abyss" />

==Behind the scenes==
Zal was created by author [[Troy Denning]] for his first installment, and the third novel overall, in the [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series, ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]'', released [[August 18]], [[2009]]. Zal later appeared in ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Vortex]]'' and ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]'', the sixth and ninth novels of the series, respectively, both by Denning.
